genotype_to_drug_rule: Under primary reading strict_perfect, calls R when any Perfect or Strict RGI hit annotates the mapped ARO Antibiotic or Drug Class token; excludes Loose hits. Reading strict_perfect_no_efflux additionally filters pure antibiotic efflux hits.

i_handling.description: CARD RGI emits Cut_Off tiers (Perfect/Strict/Loose) rather than clinical I; Loose hits are excluded under strict_perfect and any I token is counted separately and never mapped to S.
